notes.text: The page begins Exercice 4.10.6. It assumes a U-site S whose topology is less fine than the canonical topology, and an underlined M-like class of arrows satisfying conditions a)–d): base-change stability, identities and composition, a covering-local condition, and refinement by arrows in that class.
notes.basis: Observation: heading, opening and conditions a–d. No theorem or equivalence was proved in this reader run.

notes.text: The definition paragraph has two x-cancelled phrases. The first reads considérons le site and is replaced above by notons. The second reads dont la catégorie sous-jacente est and is replaced above by constitué par. The typed insertion le site is in the far left margin and its looped pointer matches one just after the parenthetical petit site de X.
notes.basis: Observation: half a and crops 04–05. The reading records insertion placement, not an inferred editorial chronology beyond the visible cancellation/addition.

notes.text: Item 1 asks for a pretopology formed by the covering families with arrows in the designated class. Item 2 asks for continuity of base change and writes the resulting functor S(u)^*:S(Y)^sim→S(X)^sim. The page really has two closing parentheses in the ensuing reference (III 1.2,iv)).
notes.basis: Observation: half b, item 1 and item 2 through the postdisplay sentence. This is a report of the requested mathematics, not a proof check.

notes.text: Item 3 begins an equivalence with systems (F_X), (varphi_u), states the objects F_X and the morphisms varphi_u:S(u)^*(F_Y)→F_X, and ends this page with ces systèmes. No continuation has been consulted.
notes.basis: Observation: half b, item 3 and bottom text.
